summary: Upright piano (sampled): intimate, a little worn, lofi and indie
label: upright piano
body: Close and soft: lofi chords, sparse melodies. Pairs with production/lofi.

Register: MIDI 36-96 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: Upright Piano KW/Upright Piano KW, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "Upright Piano KW/Upright Piano KW") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
